frequency_question: How often do national bank employee federations complete all mandatory procedural steps and initiate an indefinite strike within a 62-day window from the formal declaration of impasse?
membership_rule: Includes all instances where a multi-union bank federation in the jurisdiction reached an impasse and attempted to schedule and execute an indefinite strike. Excludes single-bank localized strikes or disputes resolved prior to strike notice.
coverage_note: 8 major national bank union strike notice cycles identified; comprehensive for major coordinated actions in the past two decades.
known_gaps: Some localized or minor bipartite warning strikes under 24 hours may not be fully cataloged.
multiplier: 8 historical escalation cycles evaluated for time-to-strike completion within 62 days
validity_reason: Labor laws and statutory conciliation frameworks governing the banking sector remain stable over medium-term horizons.
